summary: Full backend + frontend testing for L&A Gebäudereinigung demo. All 10 backend pytest cases pass (contact CRUD + validation + 404s). Frontend homepage: all 8 sections present, DE/EN language toggle works and persists across reload, all 6 FAQ accordions expand, Lenis smooth scroll nav works, fill-demo-data fills all fields incl Radix select, contact form submits successfully to POST /api/contact with sonner success toast and resets. Admin page: rows load, search filter, status change (new -> contacted) persists via API, delete with confirm removes row, CSV export button visible, back link returns to home. No blocking issues found.

issues: Empty form triggers browser-native HTML5 required validation tooltip (because inputs use required attribute) instead of the app's sonner error toast defined in submit(). The JS check `if(!form.name...) toast.error(t.contact.required)` is effectively unreachable. Not a bug, but the spec item 'empty form shows error toast' is not observed — either remove HTML5 required or drop the JS check.

action_items: Optional: reconcile HTML5 `required` attributes vs. JS toast.error(required) in Contact.jsx — the JS toast never fires because native validation blocks submit first.
Minor console warning during smooth scroll: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position...' — inspect Lenis wrapper container CSS (position: relative/absolute).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: `send_notification` correctly guards on missing RESEND_API_KEY/NOTIFY_EMAIL and returns False — matches expected email_sent=false in demo mode.
server.py list_contacts projects out _id (good), sort by created_at desc (ISO string sort works because dates are ISO 8601 UTC).
Admin.jsx has no auth — any unauthenticated visitor to /admin can view/modify/delete submissions. For anything past demo, add auth.

Contact.jsx maps service key to translation title before POST; admin filter uses translated service string. If user toggles language between submissions the same service could produce two different service strings in DB (e.g., 'Büroreinigung' vs 'Office Cleaning'), fragmenting the admin service filter list.
Files are all well below 700 lines; env-based URLs used correctly; data-testid coverage is excellent.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create+delete TEST_ prefixed rows within same run. Frontend test cleaned up remaining submissions via API at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — runs against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Admin has no auth. RESEND_API_KEY empty by design (email_sent expected false). Radix Select in admin exposes options via role=option; status labels are 'Neu/Kontaktiert/Abgeschlossen' when lang=DE.
